@echo off
echo Restoring Maximum Network Download Speeds...
netsh int tcp set global autotuninglevel=normal >nul 2>&1
Reg.exe delete "HKLM\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Services\Tcpip\Parameters" /v "GlobalMaxTcpWindowSize" /f >nul 2>&1
Reg.exe delete "HKLM\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Services\Tcpip\Parameters" /v "TcpWindowSize" /f >nul 2>&1
echo Network speeds restored. Restart your PC.
pause
